summary: Defines a new VCCV control channel type for pseudowires carried over MPLS that do not use the control word. It uses the Generic Associated Channel Label from RFC 5586 to distinguish control packets from user data.

eli5.summary: A special flag marks health-check packets so they are not mistaken for ordinary traffic.
